crossRefs.note: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…

translations.web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
translations.bsb: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
translations.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
translations.asv: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.
